Send a short start-and-run video (include sound) to confirm no knock and stable idle.
Send close-ups of gasket/seal areas and underside/oil pan area to support “never opened.”
Send photos confirming all accessories/sensors/mounts are present (starter, alternator, sensors, mounts, intake/exhaust manifolds).
response.reason: The seller’s text asserts the claims, but without new photos/videos or readable engine identification, the key facts (identity, mileage, and running/no-knock condition) remain unverified remotely. A reliable worst-case price still can’t be set from the current evidence.
